title: swirlio
tagline: p2p token trading platform that lets users put up public offers
description: p2p token trading platform that lets users put up public offers and then counter parties can accept or put up new offers. mostly for item trading but can be migrated to anything. think of it like the item trading part of the world of warcraft where two players put up offers to each other
how_its_made: I used rainbowkit, wagmi, walletconnect, react, foundry. I was thinking about the trade item ui of world of warcraft, it cant be executed without the two parties consent. mostly for item trading but can be migrated to anything. think of it like the item trading part of the world of warcraft where two players put up offers to each other
